units.text: INT. HUSBAND - CONTINUOUS
And now may I walk through your beautiful house? I hear your pictures are charming. Poor Baron Arnheim—you remember the Baron?—used to tell me you had some wonderful Corots.
units.name: MRS. CHEVELEY

units.text: With an almost imperceptible start .
Did you know Baron Arnheim well?
units.name: SIR ROBERT CHILTERN

units.text: Smiling .
Intimately. Did you?
units.name: MRS. CHEVELEY

units.text: At one time.
units.name: SIR ROBERT CHILTERN

units.text: Wonderful man, wasn’t he?
units.name: MRS. CHEVELEY

units.text: After a pause .
He was very remarkable, in many ways.
units.name: SIR ROBERT CHILTERN

units.text: I often think it such a pity he never wrote his memoirs. They would have been most interesting.
units.name: MRS. CHEVELEY

units.text: Yes: he knew men and cities well, like the old Greek.
units.name: SIR ROBERT CHILTERN

units.text: Without the dreadful disadvantage of having a Penelope waiting at home for him.
units.name: MRS. CHEVELEY

units.text: Lord Goring.
units.name: MASON

units.text: Enter LORD GORING.
Thirty-four , but always says he is younger .
A well-bred , expressionless face .
He is clever , but would not like to be thought so .
A flawless dandy , he would be annoyed if he were considered romantic .
He plays with life , and is on perfectly good terms with the world .
He is fond of being misunderstood .
It gives him a post of vantage .
Good evening, my dear Arthur! Mrs. Cheveley, allow me to introduce to you Lord Goring, the idlest man in London.
units.name: SIR ROBERT CHILTERN

units.text: I have met Lord Goring before.
units.name: MRS. CHEVELEY

units.text: Bowing .
I did not think you would remember me, Mrs. Cheveley.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: My memory is under admirable control. And are you still a bachelor?
units.name: MRS. CHEVELEY

units.text: believe so.
units.name: LORD GORING. I . .

units.text: How very romantic!
units.name: MRS. CHEVELEY

units.text: Oh! I am not at all romantic. I am not old enough. I leave romance to my seniors.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: Lord Goring is the result of Boodle’s Club, Mrs. Cheveley.
units.name: SIR ROBERT CHILTERN

units.text: He reflects every credit on the institution.
units.name: MRS. CHEVELEY

units.text: May I ask are you staying in London long?
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: That depends partly on the weather, partly on the cooking, and partly on Sir Robert.
units.name: MRS. CHEVELEY

units.text: You are not going to plunge us into a European war, I hope?
units.name: SIR ROBERT CHILTERN

units.text: There is no danger, at present!
units.name: MRS. CHEVELEY

units.text: She nods to LORD GORING, with a look of amusement in her eyes , and goes out with SIR ROBERT CHILTERN.
LORD GORING saunters over to MABEL CHILTERN.
You are very late!
units.name: MABEL CHILTERN

units.text: Have you missed me?
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: Awfully!
units.name: MABEL CHILTERN

units.text: Then I am sorry I did not stay away longer. I like being missed.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: How very selfish of you!
units.name: MABEL CHILTERN

units.text: I am very selfish.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: You are always telling me of your bad qualities, Lord Goring.
units.name: MABEL CHILTERN

units.text: I have only told you half of them as yet, Miss Mabel!
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: Are the others very bad?
units.name: MABEL CHILTERN

units.text: Quite dreadful! When I think of them at night I go to sleep at once.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: Well, I delight in your bad qualities. I wouldn’t have you part with one of them.
units.name: MABEL CHILTERN

units.text: How very nice of you! But then you are always nice. By the way, I want to ask you a question, Miss Mabel. Who brought Mrs. Cheveley here? That woman in heliotrope, who has just gone out of the room with your brother?
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: Oh, I think Lady Markby brought her. Why do you ask?
units.name: MABEL CHILTERN

units.text: I haven’t seen her for years, that is all.
units.name: LORD GORING

units.text: What an absurd reason!
units.name: MABEL CHILTERN

units.text: All reasons are absurd.
units.name: LORD GORING
